context: Seed-stage consumer AI hardware startup, 6 people, shipping a physical device with a companion app and cloud backend. First non-founder engineering hire.
abar_legs: L1 Shipped a consumer-facing product end to end: frontend AND backend AND deploy, personally owned. Evidence = named product + public URL.
L2 Built software that talks to physical devices or real-time device data: BLE, USB/serial, MQTT, firmware/OTA, camera or sensor streams, robotics telemetry.
L3 Startup autonomy: founder, founding/first-5 engineer, employee at a sub-20-person company, or solo maintainer of a real OSS project (>= 200 stars).
L4 SF Bay Area, or explicitly available for US-remote with stated US work authorization.
L5 At least 2 distinct public evidence URLs, all resolving.
exclude: ML researchers with no shipped product
agency or contract-shop profiles with no owned product
evidence only behind a login wall
no stated US work authorization or US-remote availability
